title: Custom PCR Preparation Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Gather equipment and consumables
steps.instruction: Collect the following items: Single‑Channel Pipette (Opentrons P300 Single‑Channel GEN2), Temperature Module (GEN2), NEST 96‑well PCR plate, Opentrons tips, 2 mL NEST screw‑cap tubes (or equivalent) in an Opentrons aluminum block containing PCR reagents, and the purified nucleic‑acid elution plate. Choose one of the five available mastermix compositions.

steps.title: Create reaction mix
steps.instruction: Using the Single‑Channel Pipette, prepare the reaction mix in a 2 mL tube placed in the aluminum block.

steps.title: Transfer samples and mix
steps.instruction: Move the purified DNA from the elution plate to the NEST qPCR plate and combine each sample with the prepared reaction mix.

substeps.instruction: Transfer each DNA sample from the elution plate to the corresponding well of the qPCR plate.
Add the appropriate volume of reaction mix to each well.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: Add any custom labware files to the OT App.

substeps.instruction: In the OT App, go to More > Custom Labware > Add Labware.
Select the required .json labware files and confirm upload.

steps.title: Upload protocol file
steps.instruction: Load the protocol script into the OT App.

substeps.instruction: Navigate to the Protocol tab in the OT App.
Upload the .py protocol file and save.

steps.title: Set up deck layout
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the provided deck map.

substeps.instruction: Place the Temperature Module, PCR plate, tip rack, tube block, and any other labware in the positions shown on the deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Perform calibration of all labware, tip rack, and the Single‑Channel Pipette using the OT App.

substeps.instruction: Follow the OT App calibration wizard for each piece of labware.
Use calibration tips as instructed in the support articles.
